findings.title: 3AM Hits European Schools: A Hybrid AI Ransomware Attack, Part Human, Part Agentic Loop
findings.summary_md: Bitdefender published this research describing a 3AM ransomware affiliate intrusion at a UK school estate. The attacker encrypted about 37 of nearly 50 machines from an unmanaged host, used a modified PowerShell tool against three Veeam backup servers, and deployed Mimikatz and LSASS dumpers. Researchers noted a sequence of slightly modified commands issued at regular intervals of roughly 40 to 100 seconds, which they interpreted as possible AI-assisted agentic behavior. The initial access method could not be established, and the threat actor created backdoor domain administrator accounts named library and svc_bkpmon before encryption.
